dimensions.summary: Candidate identity, fact, provider, ontology, graph, generation, quality, lineage, n-ary and cache contracts preserve the accepted Graph truth boundary.
Provider capabilities, ontology families, bounded facts and extensible contract versions are explicit and fail closed before composition.
Canonicalization and contract admission enforce finite depth, item and issue budgets while the packed package remains below its declared compressed-size ceiling.
Traversal, absolute identity, forged proof, invalid authority, recursive payload and graph-amplification cases are rejected through bounded semantic admission.
Portable proof locators, explicit redaction and package allowlists prevent absolute paths, secret values and internal governance material from entering consumer artifacts.
Portable identities and isolated packed consumption pass locally; same-commit Linux, macOS and Windows evidence is automated and still pending retention.
Graph imports Shared only through four admitted public subpaths, has no CLI dependency and exposes no runtime bridge or second graph implementation.
Canonical JSON and SHA-256 replay are insertion-order invariant; identities, relation semantics, proof lineage, conflicts, unknowns and generation dependencies are semantically validated.
Every candidate contract is independently versioned and content-addressed; unsupported Shared or Graph versions and unauthorized domain migration are rejected.
Partial, stale, unknown, unsupported, cancelled and failed provider states remain distinguishable with bounded diagnostics and complete processing accounting.
Generated wire types, semantic validators, reusable fixtures, permanent architecture guards and enforced coverage keep the candidate surface traceable and testable.
Publication is blocked by two manifest guards; separately packed Shared and Graph consumers prove declared exports while source, tests, scripts, governance, coverage and maps remain excluded.

checks.evidence: Generated-contract drift, typecheck, lint, format, coverage, tests, build and isolated packed consumer pass.
Independent package quality, boundaries, mirrors, Shared adoption and Graph package gates pass.
Same-commit Linux, macOS and Windows foundation admission artifacts have not yet been retained.

remainingRisks: The automated same-commit Linux, Windows and macOS admission candidate must be retained before approval.
G2 deterministic composition, proof policy and conflict resolution are not implemented.
Rust/native acceleration remains prohibited until TypeScript reference semantics exist and G6 measurements justify it.

approval.rule: A signed maintainer checkpoint plus retained same-commit Linux, Windows and macOS G1 conformance evidence authorizes G2 composition work.
